description: This file defines a Python class 'BitBucketClient' that provides methods to interact with BitBucket API, including fetching file contents, listing files, getting repository info, and branch info. It serves as a client library for integrating with BitBucket repositories within a larger application.

classes.name: BitBucketClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with BitBucket API to fetch files, list repository info, branches, and metadata, supporting authentication and error handling.

methods.name: __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Initializes the BitBucketClient with configuration parameters like workspace, repository, access token, branch, base URL, and authentication method.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_file_content(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Fetches the content of a specified file from the BitBucket repository, decoding base64 content if necessary.

methods.name: List[str] list_files( self, directory_path: str = "", file_extension: str = ".prompt" )
methods.description: Lists files with a specific extension within a directory in the repository.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_repository_info(self)
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information about the repository.

methods.name: bool test_connection(self)
methods.description: Tests connection to the repository by attempting to retrieve repository info.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_branches(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of branch information dictionaries from the repository.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_file_metadata(self, file_path: str)
methods.description: Fetches metadata details (content type, length, last modified) for a specific file.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes the HTTP handler to free resources.

ctags.name: get_file_metadata
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_file_metadata(self, file_path: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
